promptIntro: A prompt tells the AI how your organisation replies: its tone, its rules. One is ready. Read it, make it yours, and add others now or later in Prompts.
workIntro: How much the AI does before you open an email. Whatever you choose, nothing is sent until someone confirms it.
workLegend: For every member of the organisation
manualHint: Every email of the watched folder is to handle. The AI writes only when I ask. Nothing is sent to it until then.
sortHint: The AI sets aside what needs no reply and suggests a prompt. It reads the sender, the subject, the beginning of the text and attachment names.
draftHint: As above, and a proposal is written at fetch for each email to handle. Their content is sent to the AI without anyone asking.
mailboxHint: As above, and each proposal is filed in the Drafts folder of the mailbox, to finish and send from my mail client.
needsKey: Needs an AI key, which was not given.
workLater: This can be changed at any time in Settings → Organisation.
finish: Apply and open a first email
tryIt: This is your first email here. Write a few words on what to answer, or nothing at all, then “Write with”. Nothing is sent until you confirm.
tryPrepared: This is your first email here, with the proposal prepared for it. Read it, change what you want, then Send. Nothing is sent until you confirm.
